provenance.note: Owner-authorized reviewed chapter 7 production authoring, 5 October 2026. All 36 individual canonical/source screen/activity/exercise identities, retained variants, 29/25 physical responses, 10+8/9+9 partitions, observed support timing and analytical indexing remain preserved. Literal Japanese, readings, explanations, translations, banks and accepted alternatives are app authored/adapted, not recovered quotations. Dictionary-form typed できる/dekiru is occurrence-specific with fixed の. Contrastive は marks contextual contrast without guaranteeing exhaustive exclusion or possible alternatives. Limited feedback has cues only; unknown feedback is supplied app content. No retry, speaking or optional production endpoint.

policies.assessment: One equal-weight outcome per graded base screen; required completion is distinct from accuracy.
policies.incorrectResponses: Existing locked feedback, checked typed input and final token placement; no retry is configured.
policies.audio: Existing Japanese TTS replaces retained media. Hidden listening scripts and translations remain absent before answers. Documented limited feedback omits full transcripts and corrected-source replay. The connected two-person listening exchange uses one authored alternating-turn TTS script.
policies.visuals: Existing replaceable visual slots; original media is deferred.

unresolvedSourceFacts: Exact source literal wording, exhaustive accepted alternatives, original media assets and acoustic alignment remain unavailable; reviewed app copy supplies complete content.
Research scores and source unlock rules do not seed app progress.

screens.prompt: Study which combinations express contrast in this lesson.

cells: で・に・と・から・まで + は
Retain the role particle, then add contrastive は.
Object を or subject が → は
Use は in place of を or が for this contrastive pattern.
Direct をは・がは・もは・やは
Do not use these as the taught contrastive combinations.

after.text: この店では、カードが使えます。
after.secondary: この みせでは、かーどが つかえます。

after.text: At this shop, you can use a card.

For these contrastive patterns, retain で・に・と・から・まで before は. は normally replaces object を or subject が rather than following them directly. Direct をは・がは・もは・やは are not the target combinations here; this is not a universal ban on every particle sequence.
